item.title: [ 4 Maps ] Tidal Fever
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
A reimagining of Swamp Fever, transforming the environment from the deep murky Louisiana swamp into a tropical paradise Map layouts and events are mostly the same, with some changes here and there. Most notable change being map 3 tiny bridge event turned into a 2 stage barricade burning panic event, and the Plantation hold out event now stay entirely outdoor. Map name in the console: c3m1_jungle c3m2_jungle c3m3_jungle c3m4_jungle Special Thanks to Playtesters and feedbacks: - Konsta★Starlight - Sunny Moly - Warhawk - DeadlyGinja - Tyda - DARG - aim - Withgreen1 - Nicole - Hope Soda - halulu - Levin - zombieatomic115 Credit: Crowbar Collective - Textures Mr. Who/komaokc/Hsyenoh05 - Skybox textures Konsta★Starlight - Screenshot, general assistance 7EMPEST - Mapping, models, scripts, SFX/music

# MODS Of Chaos Welcome to **MODS Of Chaos**, where Left 4 Dead 2 becomes an absolute nightmare. This add-on collection is built for players who want fast, brutal, and unpredictable gameplay. Expect **Nightmare difficulty**, **Speedrun mechanics**, powerful **Script Add-ons**, strange and cursed Workshop mods, random surprises, enhanced infected behavior, overpowered weapons, visual chaos, and moments that make no sense—but somehow work. ## Includes * Nightmare Gameplay * Speedrun-Friendly Features * Script Add-ons * Weird & Cursed Add-ons * Custom Weapon Scripts * Enhanced Special Infected * Faster Gameplay * Random Events * Meme & Fun Content * HD Effects and Sounds * Quality-of-Life Improvements * Multiplayer Compatible Every campaign is different. Every mistake can end your run. Whether you're surviving with friends or challenging yourself solo, expect nonstop action from the saferoom to the rescue vehicle. **Warning:** This collection is intentionally chaotic. Some add-ons may be difficult, unfair, hilarious, or completely unexpected. **Can you survive the chaos... or will the chaos survive you?**
